messages:
pat: Postmortem follow-up for 2025-03-15 incident. We need clear owners for runbook edits, an explicit escalation flow (who calls who), and a short recurring check to surface the eviction ramp earlier. Volunteers?
nia: I can handle the runbook triage rewrite. I'll add exact verification commands and a short decision tree for next steps.
sam-oncall: I'll own escalation/fallbacks. There's confusion about cross-zone paging; I'll add a one-page emergency script and a RACI.
li: I'll add a canary probe to the dedicated pool and wire a dashboard panel. Suggest the probe run every 30s and alert at 3 failures.
pat: Example commands to include in triage: `kubectl get pods -A --field-selector=status.phase!=Running -o wide`, `kubectl describe node <node>` and a prometheus query: `sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) by (zone)`.
nia: Good. I'll include a short snippet to check KV cache hitratio: `curl -s $PROM/prom/api/v1/query?query=kv_cache_hitratio | jq .` and a one-liner to list pods with eviction events.
ops-bot: Created INF-4901: "Runbook edits & triage commands" assigned to nia. Created INF-4902: "Escalation script + RACI" assigned to sam-oncall. Due 2025-04-06.
sam-oncall: I'll also add an autodial fallback in the playbook if pages are not acked in 2 minutes. Will publish phone roster and schedule a 2-week verification.
li: Canary probe YAML I'll add to the PR: `readinessProbe: exec: command: ["/bin/sh","-c","curl -sf http://localhost:8080/health || exit 2"] periodSeconds: 30 failureThreshold: 3`.
nia: ETA: PR for runbook by EOD tomorrow. Will include decision tree, commands, dashboard links, and a drill checklist.
pat: Thanks all. Action recap: nia -> runbook PR; sam-oncall -> escalation + roster; li -> canary probe + dashboard; ops-bot -> track tickets. We'll reconvene in 2 weeks to confirm recurrence suppressed.
